title: promoter-sequence-transcription-rates
summary: A research codebase of Jupyter notebooks exploring machine-learning models to predict transcription rates from bacterial promoter sequences, testing generative models like CTGAN and TVAE to augment training data. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAE synthesizers, along with SDV's metadata and evaluation utilities, to generate and validate synthetic promoter data.
